JsonLogic.title: JSON Logic Expression
JsonLogic.description: Generic JSON Logic expression. See jsonlogic.com. Not strictly validated here.

cover.description: Preferred: asset catalog id. Also accepts URI for static bundles.

balloonConfig.description: Per-character balloon style overrides (merged onto work-level defaults)

folders.description: Since schema 1.5: authoring asset-library folder tree. Rendering consumers may ignore this block.

folderIds.description: Since schema 1.5: ids of assets.folders entries this asset is filed under (n:m). Rendering consumers may ignore this field.

Localization.title: Localization
Localization.description: Since schema 1.5: translation workflow state (authoring metadata). Rendering consumers may ignore this block.

mime.description: Optional since schema 1.2: when omitted, consumers derive the MIME type from the src file extension (png, jpg/jpeg, webp, gif, avif -> image/*). Required when src has no recognizable extension.

Optional since schema 1.2: when omitted, consumers derive the MIME type from the src file extension (mp3 -> audio/mpeg, m4a -> audio/mp4, ogg, wav -> audio/*). Required when src has no recognizable extension.

Optional since schema 1.2: when omitted, consumers derive the MIME type from the src file extension (mp4 -> video/mp4, webm -> video/webm, m3u8 -> application/vnd.apple.mpegurl). Required when src has no recognizable extension.

direction.description: Playback direction of this variant (schema 1.1+). `reverse` marks a pre-rendered, time-reversed encode (video only, typically without audio) used for smooth `pingpong` playback; the player falls back to frame-stepping when no `reverse` variant is available.

mime.description: Optional since schema 1.2: when omitted, consumers derive the MIME type from the src file extension (vtt -> text/vtt, srt -> application/x-subrip). Required when src has no recognizable extension.
Optional since schema 1.2: when omitted, consumers derive the MIME type from the src file extension (svg -> image/svg+xml, pdf -> application/pdf). Required when src has no recognizable extension.

poster.description: Poster/preview frame shown before playback starts (schema 1.1+), e.g. for click-to-play and reduced-motion presentations.

typography.description: Global typography and styling defaults for the work

balloon_config.description: Default balloon styling for all speech bubbles in this work

textStyles.description: Named, reusable text style presets (schema 1.3+). Keys are preset names; TextLayer.styleRef references a key. Resolution cascade: work typography defaults -> referenced preset -> the layer's inline `style` (inline fields win). Like CSS classes: restyle every referencing layer by editing the preset once.

balloonPresets.description: Named, reusable balloon style presets (schema 1.3+). Keys are preset names; SpeechBubble.styleRef references a key. Merged into the balloon cascade as: work balloon_config -> character balloonConfig -> referenced preset -> the bubble's inline balloonConfig (inline fields win).

speechDefault.description: Initial state of the reader's speech-bubble toggle. Since schema 1.3, ALL speech bubbles are implicitly gated by this toggle — manifests must not (and need not) replicate it via per-bubble visibleIf; visibleIf is reserved for story logic.

videoPlayModeDefault.description: Work-level default for VideoLayer `playMode` (schema 1.1+), used when a layer does not specify its own `playMode`. Cascades work default -> per-layer override.

videoStartModeDefault.description: Work-level default for VideoLayer `startMode` (schema 1.1+), used when a layer does not specify its own `startMode`. Cascades work default -> per-layer override.

videoMutedDefault.description: Work-level default for VideoLayer `muted` (schema 1.1+), used when a layer does not specify its own `muted`. Cascades work default -> per-layer override.

canvasView.description: Enable infinite-canvas view for this output format. A chapter renders in canvas view only when this is true AND the chapter defines a canvas layout; otherwise players fall back to panel view. Added in 1.4.

defaultCameraMove.description: Default camera move for edges without an explicit cameraMove when this format renders in canvas view. Added in 1.4.

chapterId.description: CMS database chapter UUID. Used by the editor for API calls; not required by the player.

sequenceAudioTracks.description: Audio tracks that span multiple panels within this chapter

canvas.description: Optional infinite-canvas layout: places this chapter's panels on one continuous world-space plane. The graph remains the trail (reading order); canvas only adds spatial position. Chapters without a canvas render in panel/page view as before. Added in 1.4.

pageId.description: CMS-internal database identifier for the page (UUID). Used by the editor for API calls; players may ignore it.

background_image.description: Background image asset ID or URI

background_texture.description: Background texture asset ID or URI

transitions.description: Transition effects for entering and leaving this page

in.description: Transition effect when entering this page

out.description: Transition effect when leaving this page

canvasSize.description: Reference canvas size for CMS editor UI only (not used for player rendering)

gridHelper.description: Optional grid visual helper for CMS editor

x.description: X position (normalized: 0 = left edge, 1 = right edge)

y.description: Y position (normalized: 0 = top edge, 1 = bottom edge)

w.description: Width (normalized: 0-1 = 0-100% of page width, >1 allows overflow)

h.description: Height (normalized: 0-1 = 0-100% of page height, >1 allows overflow)

z.description: Z-index for overlapping panels (higher = on top)

vx.description: Visible area X position relative to panel (normalized: 0 = left edge, 1 = right edge). If omitted, full panel is visible.

vy.description: Visible area Y position relative to panel (normalized: 0 = top edge, 1 = bottom edge). If omitted, full panel is visible.

vw.description: Visible area width (normalized: 0-1 = 0-100% of panel width). If omitted, full panel width is visible.

vh.description: Visible area height (normalized: 0-1 = 0-100% of panel height). If omitted, full panel height is visible.

transition.description: Optional. When omitted, the player uses the active output format's settings.outputPresets[format].defaultTransition; if no preset defines one, it falls back to a plain cut. Exporters should only write transitions that differ from the format default.

cameraMove.description: Optional. Camera travel used when this edge is traversed in canvas view. When omitted, the player uses the active format's settings.outputPresets[format].defaultCameraMove; if none, a built-in direct move (hold zoom, 800ms, ease-in-out). Ignored outside canvas view; transition still applies in panel view. Added in 1.4.

mutations.description: Editor edge metadata/mutation ops (e.g. hotspot/edge-type descriptors).

WorldPoint.title: World Point
WorldPoint.description: A point on the infinite-canvas plane. World units: 1 unit = 1 CSS pixel at zoom 1.0. Unbounded; negatives allowed. Added in 1.4.

WorldRect.title: World Rect
WorldRect.description: A rectangle on the infinite-canvas plane in world units. Added in 1.4.

CameraMove.title: Camera Move
CameraMove.description: Animated world-space camera travel between two panels in canvas view. Lives on graph edges (and as a format default). Added in 1.4.

waypoints.description: Intermediate world-space points the camera passes through. Only used when path is "waypoints".

zoomProfile.description: hold = keep framing zoom; pull-back = zoom out far enough to see source and target, glide, zoom back in; dive = straight zoom into the target.

reducedMotionFallback.description: Transition used instead of the camera glide when the reader prefers reduced motion. Players default to a short fade when omitted.

CanvasPlacement.title: Canvas Placement
CanvasPlacement.description: Position and size of one panel on the infinite-canvas plane, in world units (1 unit = 1 CSS pixel at zoom 1.0; by convention panels use their natural authoring size, e.g. 1024x576). Added in 1.4.

z.description: Stacking order on the plane; overlapping panels are allowed.

origin.description: Rotation/transform origin, normalized to the placement (0.5/0.5 = center).

enterFraming.description: Panel-relative rect the camera frames when this panel becomes current. Defaults to the whole panel (fit per camera policy).

revealMode.description: always = visible whenever on screen; on-approach = revealed when the camera nears it; on-visit = hidden/dimmed until the trail reaches it (spoiler protection in overview zoom).

CanvasDecoration.title: Canvas Decoration
CanvasDecoration.description: Non-panel set dressing placed on the infinite-canvas plane (arrows, scenery, trail markers). Purely presentational. Added in 1.4.

parallaxDepth.description: Parallax factor relative to camera movement (0 = locked to the plane).

CanvasCameraPolicy.title: Canvas Camera Policy
CanvasCameraPolicy.description: Chapter-level camera behavior in canvas view. Added in 1.4.

fitMode.description: How a panel's framing rect is fitted into the viewport on arrival.

maxZoomOut.description: Lowest allowed zoom factor (world scale) when zooming out to the overview.

freeRoam.description: off = camera only moves along the trail (webtoon-like); between-moves = reader may pan/zoom while idle; always = fully free camera.

bounds.description: Camera travel bounds: "auto" = union of placements plus margin, or an explicit world rect.

CanvasLayout.title: Canvas Layout
CanvasLayout.description: Infinite-canvas layout for a chapter: all placed panels share one continuous world-space plane; the reader's viewport travels across it along the graph. Added in 1.4.

placements.description: Map of panel id (must exist in the chapter's panels) to its world-space placement. Every panel reachable from the graph entry should have a placement; players lay out stray panels heuristically and validators warn.

placement.description: Editor placement of the panel within its page layout (normalized x/y/w/h, rotation, grid rows/columns).

durationMs.description: Duration in milliseconds for autoplay. Overrides global secondsPerPanel setting for this specific panel.

variants.description: Conditional content variants, evaluated in order — the first whose `when` matches applies (base panel when none match).

PanelAnimations.description: Animation of one panel: an optional camera move (startViewportRect -> endViewportRect) and/or layer keyframes. Both share durationMs. The animation starts when the panel is shown (panel view: it becomes the current panel; page and canvas view: it scrolls into view).

name.description: Human-friendly animation name (authoring aid). Players ignore it.

durationMs.description: Total running time. When omitted, keyframe animations run until their last keyframe.

easing.description: Easing of the camera move. Keyframes carry their own easing.

loop.description: Restart the animation from 0 when durationMs is reached. When false, the end state holds.

keyframes.description: Layer keyframes. All keyframes with the same layerId and property form one track, ordered by timeMs. Before a track's first keyframe its first value holds, after its last keyframe its last value holds; between two keyframes the value is interpolated using the easing of the earlier one. Keyframes whose layerId matches no layer of the panel are ignored. With a reduced-motion preference players skip the motion and show the end state.

property.description: Animated property. opacity: 0-1, replaces the layer's opacity. transform.x / transform.y: offset from the layer's resting position as a fraction of the panel's width / height (0.1 = 10 % to the right / down, negative = left / up). transform.scale: scale factor around the layer's center (1 = unchanged). transform.rotation: degrees clockwise around the layer's center. blur: blur radius in px at a panel width of 1024 px (players scale it with the rendered panel width). brightness / contrast / saturate: multiplier (1 = unchanged).

timeMs.description: Position of the keyframe on the animation's timeline.

easing.description: Easing applied from this keyframe to the next one of the same track.

locked.description: Editor state: layer locked from selection/edits.

visibleRect.description: Defines the visible area of the image layer. If omitted, the full layer is visible. Hidden areas are rendered at reduced opacity in the editor.

autoplay.description: Legacy field (schema 1.0). Superseded by `startMode`. If `startMode` is absent: `autoplay: true` is interpreted as `startMode: "on-view"`; explicit `autoplay: false` is interpreted as `startMode: "on-click"`. Ignored when `startMode` is present.

loop.description: Legacy field (schema 1.0). Superseded by `playMode`. If `playMode` is absent, `loop: true` is interpreted as `playMode: "loop"`. Ignored when `playMode` is present.

playMode.description: Playback mode (schema 1.1+). `once`: play through and freeze on the last frame. `loop`: play from `startAtMs` to the end, seek back, repeat. `pingpong`: play forward then backward then forward, repeating; prefers a `direction: "reverse"` VideoVariant for the backward pass, otherwise the player frame-steps backward. `loop-from`: play once from `startAtMs` to the end, then loop endlessly from `loopFromMs` to the end. Takes precedence over the legacy `loop` field when present; when absent, `loop: true` is treated as `playMode: "loop"`.

loopFromMs.description: Loop re-entry point in milliseconds, only used when `playMode` is `"loop-from"`. Absolute media time on the video's own timeline (independent of `startAtMs`). Constraint (not enforceable in JSON Schema): `startAtMs <= loopFromMs < ` the asset's `durationMs`.

startMode.description: Playback start trigger (schema 1.1+). `on-view`: starts when the panel becomes current (panel view) or when the placement enters the viewport (page view). `on-hover`: starts on mouseover; page view only, falls back to `on-click` in panel view and on touch devices. `on-click`: starts on click/tap and toggles play/pause thereafter. Takes precedence over the legacy `autoplay` field when present; when absent, `autoplay: true` is treated as `startMode: "on-view"` and explicit `autoplay: false` as `startMode: "on-click"`.

content.description: CMS text-layer content (plain string; alternative to the localized `text`).

styleRef.description: Name of a reusable text style preset in settings.typography.textStyles (schema 1.3+). Resolution cascade: work typography defaults -> preset -> inline `style` (inline fields win). Consumers should ignore a styleRef that has no matching preset.

style.description: Inline text style. When `styleRef` is also set, these fields override the referenced preset.

SequenceAudioTrack.description: Audio track that spans multiple panels within a chapter

id.description: Unique identifier for this audio track

format.description: Optional format filter (null = applies to all formats)

startTime.description: Start time in milliseconds relative to chapter/sequence start

shape.description: Bounding box for bubble position and size (normalized 0-1 coordinates)

styleRef.description: Name of a reusable balloon preset in settings.typography.balloonPresets (schema 1.3+). Merge cascade: work balloon_config -> character balloonConfig -> preset -> inline balloonConfig (inline fields win). Consumers should ignore a styleRef that has no matching preset.

balloonConfig.description: Per-bubble balloon style overrides (merged onto the styleRef preset, character, or work-level defaults)

visibleIf.description: Story-logic visibility condition (e.g. show a clue bubble once a variable is set). Since schema 1.3, every speech bubble is implicitly subject to the reader's global speech toggle (initial state: settings.ui.speechDefault) — the toggle is ANDed on top of this condition by the player. Do NOT encode the speech preference here (no {"var":"prefs.speech"} boilerplate); a bubble without visibleIf is simply always eligible while speech is on.

tail.description: Editor-computed balloon tail geometry (tip/anchor points, width).

textStyle.description: Editor text styling (font, color, alignment, padding).

locked.description: Editor state: bubble locked from selection/edits.

TextStyle.title: Text Style
TextStyle.description: Text layer styling. Used inline on TextLayer.style and as reusable presets in settings.typography.textStyles (schema 1.3+).

BalloonConfig.title: Balloon Configuration
BalloonConfig.description: Complete balloon styling configuration. Used at work level as defaults.

balloonType.description: Visual type of the balloon shape ('narrator' is a sharp-cornered caption box)

maxWidth.description: Maximum balloon width in pixels (balloon auto-sizes to text)

strokeWidth.description: Balloon border stroke width in pixels

tail.description: Tail configuration (pointer from balloon to speaker)

hideBorder.description: Border hiding segment for layered balloon effects

BalloonConfigOverride.title: Balloon Configuration Override
BalloonConfigOverride.description: Partial balloon styling for character-level or bubble-level overrides. Only specified fields override the parent defaults.

HideBorderConfig.title: Hide Border Configuration
HideBorderConfig.description: Hide a segment of the balloon border for layered balloon effects

angle.description: Center angle of the hidden border segment in degrees (compass: 0=top, 90=right, 180=bottom, 270=left)

arc.description: Width of the hidden segment in degrees

BoundingBox.title: Bounding Box
BoundingBox.description: Axis-aligned bounding box using normalized coordinates (0-1). Used for speech bubble positioning.

PanelVariant.description: Conditional alternate content of one panel. Variants are evaluated in array order against the current variable context; the FIRST variant whose `when` is truthy applies. Each property present in `overrides` replaces the base panel's value wholesale (no deep merge).

when.description: JSON Logic condition over the variable context; the variant applies when truthy. Evaluation errors count as false.

durationMs.description: Duration in milliseconds for autoplay. Overrides global secondsPerPanel setting for this specific panel.

alt_cover.description: One alternative cover (an ExtraBlock) or several (an array of ExtraBlocks, in display order). Exporters emit the single-object form when there is exactly one.

characterId.description: The character this sheet shows. For an ensemble sheet, the first entry of characterIds (kept so that consumers that only know characterId still resolve a character).

characterIds.description: All characters shown on this sheet (ensemble / cast sheet), in display order. When present it is the authoritative list; characterId, if also present, should equal its first entry.

products.description: Since schema 1.6: display information for the products and subscription tiers the rules sell, keyed by id. A rule references entries by id through requiredProductIds, requireEntitlement (a product key) or subscriptionTiers; readers use the matching entry's name, description and price for the Buy / Subscribe option and fall back to the rule's name/price, then to the bare id. Entries nothing references are allowed and ignored. Ids should be unique (application-level rule; JSON Schema cannot enforce it on a property).

PaywallProduct.title: PaywallProduct
PaywallProduct.description: Since schema 1.6: reader-facing information about one product or subscription tier from the host's catalogue. Informational only: which product unlocks what is decided by the rules, and the host's checkout remains the authority on the actual price.

price.description: Display price (amount + ISO 4217 currency), same shape as PaywallRule.price.

type.description: One-time purchase or subscription (tier). Informational; the referencing rule decides how the option is sold.

requiredProductIds.description: Since schema 1.6: the products (ids from the host's product catalogue; display info may be given in paywall.products) that unlock a purchase rule. A reader satisfies the rule when they own AT LEAST ONE of the listed products; readers offer one Buy option per listed product. Only meaningful when the rule is a purchase rule (entitlementType/requireEntitlement 'purchase' or a product key); other rule kinds ignore it. When absent, the pre-1.6 behaviour applies: requireEntitlement is the only product hint (a value that is not an entitlement type name names the single product to offer), and a reader that cannot resolve it treats any purchase as satisfying the rule. Exporters that target pre-1.6 readers should keep requireEntitlement set to the first listed product.
